chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Ali ibn al-Hakam, from Mansur ibn Yunus, from Anbasah, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

When the inhabitants of the Fire settle in the Fire, they will miss you, so they will not see any one of you. Then some of them will say to others: 'What is wrong with us that we do not see men whom we used to count among the wicked? Did we take them in scorn, or have our eyes turned aside from them?'
He said: And that is the Statement of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Indeed, that is the truth: the contending of the inhabitants of the Fire.'
They will dispute among themselves regarding you, concerning what they used to say about you in the world.
ai.seo_question: Why will the inhabitants of Hell fail to see the Shiites among them according to this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the eschatological realization of the inhabitants of Hell, who will search for the Shiites among the wicked only to find them absent, confirming their distinct spiritual status. This fulfills the Quranic narrative of *khasam* (disputing), where the damned argue over the faithful based on how they were perceived and described during their earthly life. The narration highlights the concept of *tazayyuf* (being counted among the elite or distinct group) and serves as a comfort to the faithful that their identity was recognized even if not always accepted by the majority.

en.hubeali: H 14552 – Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al-Hakam, from Mansour Bin Yunus, from Anbasat, who has narrated the following: Abu Abdullahasws said:

‘When the inhabitants of the Fire settle down in the Fire, they will miss you (Shiites). So they will not see any one from you (therein). So some of them will say to the others, “[38:62] And they will say: "What has happened to us that we see not men whom we used to number among the bad ones? [38:63] Was it that we (only) took them in scorn, or have our eyes (now) turned aside from them? [38:64].
Imamasws said: ‘And that is the Statement of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic: “That most surely is the truth: the contending one with another of the inmates of the fire”.

They will be disputing with each other regarding you (Shiites) with regards to what they had been saying about you (Shiites) in the world’.
